a11y: A real nav landmark of links; the current page carries aria-current="page" (styled like .on). Group buttons carry aria-expanded and the sub-list is plain links. In the rail the labels and the user name are visually hidden (1px clip), not removed, so rail links keep their text names; keep a title for a pointer tooltip. The avatar initials are aria-hidden. The script is guarded with data-kata-ready, so loading it twice toggles once per click. Spacing uses logical properties for dir="rtl".
description: The app sidebar as a part: sections, collapsible groups, badges, an icon rail variant, and the user at the foot.
title: Sidebar
usage: Drop it at the left edge of an app frame. The current page is marked by the vermillion core on its icon — the same mark the App Shell block and the templates use. Groups collapse with the small script; without the script they stay exactly as written, so write the important one open.
